headline: RM, a Superstar With BTS, Gets His Feet Wet As an Art Curator
context: RM, of BTS, brings 145 works by Korean artists to SFMOMA this fall. “I know Picasso, I know van Gogh. I don’t know anyone from my country,” he told himself as he began to buy. “You have to find your root.”
